# Command-line interface

<Tabs>
<TabItem value="sync">

Run `nimbus sync ./photos s3://bucket` to upload a directory. Use `--dry-run` to preview changes
without uploading, and `--force` to overwrite objects that changed remotely.

</TabItem>
